papers.what_it_is: A proposal and small experimental test of a minimal one-class quantum classifier (QOCC) derived from the Hadamard Classifier, run in simulation and on two IBM devices.

papers.what_it_is: A benchmark of seven state vector quantum simulators on three HPC systems for three variational-algorithm use cases (H2 VQE, MaxCut QAOA, TSP VQE), with a Hamiltonian and ansatz parser that ports one problem definition across simulators.

quotes: The 20-qubit instance of the problem presents a promising scaling on one node, however
this is already at the limit of what is possible to simulate usefully in terms of time to solution, and has a memory footprint of its quantum state of only 16 MB

papers.what_it_is: A simulation study of fidelity-quantum-kernel SVMs on hyperspectral Indian Pines and Methane Detection data, using tensor-network (cuTensorNet) simulation of up to hundreds of qubits and a bandwidth parameter, compared with an RBF kernel and standard classical baselines.

existing.note: Narrowed: the authors limit the statement to the family of fidelity kernels with low-entangling circuits. Section III-B adds that the cited simulation results are demonstrated for block-encoded states with a linear entangling strategy.
existing.value: The authors state that the fact these fidelity kernels can be simulated classically undermines their potential to deliver a robust quantum advantage, that this limitation applies only to the family of fidelity kernels with low-entangling circuits, and that other quantum kernel constructions, such as projected quantum kernels, remain classically intractable.
